# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest release and the current `main` branch. Older
snapshots are not maintained separately.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue or pull
request. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form instead:

<https://github.com/jackgraziano/shasha/security/advisories/new>

Include the affected version or commit, operating system, Git version, object
format, reproduction steps, potential impact, and any suggested mitigation.
Avoid attaching repositories or files that contain credentials or private data.

Reports will be investigated privately. Once a fix is available, the reporter
and maintainer can coordinate disclosure through a GitHub security advisory.
